text: For the director of music. According to gittith. A psalm of David. O Lord, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens.
you have ordained praise because of your enemies, to silence the foe and the avenger.
the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have set in place,
the son of man that you care for him?
and crowned him with glory and honor.
you put everything under his feet:
and the beasts of the field,
and the fish of the sea, all that swim the paths of the seas.
how majestic is your name in all the earth!
